text: Grandson, 4. Temp 39.9. Runny nose, sneezing all evening, and one eye is pink and gunky, stuck shut when he woke up. Colour is normal, no fits or shaking or anything like that. Before you ask about the purple round his mouth, that's blackcurrant juice, he's had two cups and it's all over his face, it wipes off on a flannel. I'm worn out, been up with him most of the night. What can I give him for the temperature
